title: Penalty for not furnishing information or giving false information

versions.Latest:
217. Penalty for not furnishing information or giving false information.—

—   Any 
person who is required by this Act or by any notice or by other proceedings issued 
thereunder to furnish any information, fails to furnish any information or knowingly 
furnishes false information, shall, on conviction, be punished with fine which may extend 
to one hundred rupees.
